book.name: HECHOS
book.title: JA' SK'ANEAL TZETTAJ YETAL JIX EL YUNEN EB ẌEJAB JESÚS

content: Ja' Yet Jix Apni Pablo Sattaj Naj Festo
Ja' yet jix apni naj Festo bey conob Cesarea tu' yu ẍa'on yopiso, catu' jix oc can yin yaawil. Caabi to ẍa' yopiso naj tu', catu' jix to naj bey Jerusalén.
Ja' tu' jix apni eb yaawil yak'omal xaambal eb Israel tet Dios sc'atan naj yetoj wan xa eb ey yopiso, yu yak'le queja Pablo tu' yu eb.
Jix sk'an favor eb tet Festo tu', tol chi i'letej Pablo bey Jerusalén tu'. Jix yal eb jaxca tu', yutol jix yoche eb tol ja' yul be jix smak' cam naj eb.
Pero jix yal naj tet eb jaxca ti': —Preso ye Pablo bey Cesarea tinani'. Ja' yet to jayeb c'u chin apni titu'.
Ja' to yet tu' chi ske' sto eb je yaawil bey Cesarea tu' wetoj an. Ta tol ey smul Pablo tu', chi ske' yalon eb titu', ẍi naj tet eb.

Ey mi waxajeb oj c'u ma laoneb oj c'u jix bet ec' Festo bey Jerusalén tu'. Catu' jix meltzotoj bey Cesarea. Ja' yet jun xa c'ual, catu' jix to bey sdespacho bey chi wa'xi jowal. Catu' jix bet yak'on awtele Pablo.
Ja' yet jix octoj Pablo sattaj, catu' jix oc joyan eb Israel jix tit bey Jerusalén tu' yin naj. Ec'al tzet jix tz'aj sna' a eb yin, pero c'am nioj tzet chi x'ox eb, ta tol yel chi yal eb.

Yet jix lawi yalon yet eb xin, catu' jix yalon sba Pablo jaxca ti': —C'am jin mul chi oc jin tenon tzet chi yal an ley eb wet Israelal. C'am jin mul chi oc yin stemplo Dios. Catu' c'am pax tet naj yaaw bey Roma, c'am jin mul chi oc tet naj, ẍi naj Pablo tu'.
Pero tutun chi yoche Festo watx' chi can yul sat eb Israel. Yuxan jix sk'anle tet Pablo jaxca ti': —¿Chim yoche ja c'ul chach to bey Jerusalén, yet watx' ja' tu' chin na' oc ja win? ẍi naj tet Pablo.
Jix tak'wi Pablo tu' tet naj jaxca ti': —Sattaj sdespacho naj yaaw a Roma smoo chin apni. Asan titu' chi ske' sna'le oc win. Ja wotaj tol caw c'am jin mul chi oc tet eb Israel ti'.

Ta tol ey junoj jin mul tol smoo chin cam yu, cam ojab jin yu. Pero ta c'am pax jin mul chi txeclo el yu eb Israel ti', c'am junoj mac chi ske' jin yaon oc yul sk'ab eb. Chin k'antoj jin ba tet naj yaaw bey Roma. Ja' naj oj na'on tzet oj wune, ẍi Pablo tu' tet naj Festo tu'.

Jix k'anab Festo tu' yetoj wan eb yet yaawil chi ak'on sna'bal tet naj. Catu' jix yalon tet Pablo tu' jaxca ti': —Jaachti', cha k'antoj ja ba sattaj naj yaaw bey Roma, yuxan oj jaach watoj an, ẍi Festo tet naj.
Ja' Yet Jix Apni Pablo Sattaj Naj Rey Agripa
Ey xam jayeb oj c'u tu' catu' jix apni naj rey Agripa
yetoj ix Berenice bey Cesarea tu', catu' jix jul ec' eb k'anab yetoj Festo yutol jix ẍa' yopiso.

Ec'al c'al c'ual jix ec' eb titu'. Ey jun c'ual jix yaltej Festo tet naj rey tu' tzet ye oc Pablo. Catu' jix yalontej jaxca ti': —Ja' yet jix el Félix yin yopiso, ey jun winaj chi yij Pablo ey can oc preso yu.

Ja' yet jix jin bet ec' Jerusalén, jix apni eb yaawil yak'omal xaambal eb Israel tet Dios jin c'atan an, yetoj eb ichamtaj winaj ey yopiso. Catu' jix c'oli yak'on queja Pablo eb tu' e in an. Jix yoche eb tol jix wak' orden scami.

Jix walon tet eb jaxca ti': “Pero chi yal cu ley jaon a Roma jon ti', c'am chi ske' tol comon c'al chi ak'le cam junoj mac txequel. Sowalil chi yil-le oc sat eb yetoj eb chi ak'on queja eb tu' sattaj yaaw, catu' chi scolon sba eb,” jin chi tet eb a Jerusalén tu'.
Yuxan, ja' yet jix jul eb titi', ma jin cha' meyoj tiempo an. Yewial tu', catu' jix jin octoj chotan yul jin despacho bey chin wa'ne el jowal. Jix wak'on bet tit Pablo tu'.
Ja' jin na'oni, tol miman mi smul. Pero ja' eb jix ak'on queja tu', c'am tzet jix yaoc eb yiban jaxca jix wute jin na'on tu'.

Asan janic' ti' jix yal eb, tol ey tzet pena chi yal yin scuybanil eb. Catu' jix yalontej eb yu jun naj chi yij Jesús tol camnaj xa. Pero ja' naj Pablo tu' chi aloni tol iquis pax oj. Asan yu wan tu', yuxan chi yak' queja eb.

Jainti', ma na'cha wu tzet chi wute jin wa'nen el eb an. Yuxan jix jin k'anle el tet Pablo tu' jaxca ti': “¿Chim yoche ja c'ul chach to bey Jerusalén, yet watx' ja' tu' chin na' oc ja win?” jin chi tet.

Catu' jix yalon e in jaxca ti' an: “Chin k'antoj jin ba sattaj naj yaaw bey Roma an. Ja' naj oj na'on tzet oj wun an,” ẍi Pablo tu' e in an. Yuxan jix wal an, tol chi can nioj xa preso, masanta' c'al oj watoj bey naj yaaw tu', ẍi Festo tu'.

Ja' yet jix yaben naj rey Agripa wan tu' xin, jix yalon naj tet Festo tu' jaxca ti': —Chi woche chi wab pax tzet ẍi Pablo tu' jainti', ẍi tet naj. —Ta jaxca tu', yecal to oj ja wab tzet ẍi naj, ẍi Festo tu' tet.

Ja' yet jun xa c'ual, catu' jix jul naj rey Agripa tu' yetoj ix Berenice. Ey xa smey yili eb yetoj spichil, catu' jix oc apnoj eb yul bey chi wa'xi ye jowal tu' yetoj eb yaawil eb soldado, c'al wan eb mimej winaj ey yopiso yu conob. Jix bet yak'on tit Pablo tu' naj Festo tu'.

Catu' jix yalon naj Festo jaxca ti': —Mamin rey Agripa, c'al jantaj jex jix je yamba je ba ketoj ti'. Che yil naj Pablo ti'. Ec'al eb Israel jix aloni tol ey smul. Jix yal eb bey Jerusalén. Catu' jix yalon pax eb e in an bey Cesarea ti'. Caw c'am chi sbej eb sk'anon camich yiban.
Pero chin na' jainti', c'am junoj smul smoo scam yu. Jix sk'antoj sba naj sattaj naj Augusto, yaaw bey Roma, yet watx' chi sna' naj tzet chi yune'. Yuxan chin na' tol oj watoj.

Pero c'am tzet watx' jin tz'ibentoj yin naj tet naj yaaw tu'. Yuxan chi wi'tej ja sattaj ti', Mamin rey Agripa, c'al je sattaj je masanil. Ja' tinani', k'anle wej je yab tet, ta ey pax junoj smul chi ilcha el je yu xin, catu' chin tz'ibentoj tet naj yaaw tu'.
Yutol man watx' oj chin na' an, ta ey junoj mac chi watoj preso, pero c'am chin tz'ibe pax toj smul, ẍi naj Festo tu'.

footnotes.text: Ja' jun naj Agripa chi yal yin titi', sc'aal naj rey Herodes, naj jix ochen jix ak'on cam naj Pedro chi yaltej bey Hechos 12.
